description: The LOCK MODE clause (ISO 12.4.5.9; LOCK MODE IS MANUAL/AUTOMATIC [WITH LOCK ON [MULTIPLE] RECORD(S)]) - MANUAL locks only on WITH LOCK, AUTOMATIC on every READ. 2002 introduction; 0900 below 2002.
citation: ISO §2023:12.4.5.9 (LOCK MODE IS MANUAL/AUTOMATIC [WITH LOCK ON [MULTIPLE] RECORD(S)]); 2002 introduction
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014->2023 only)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWLM.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               LOCK MODE IS MANUAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN. STOP RUN.
